headers.//: Icons and logo artwork are fixed files with fixed names. Vercel's default for unhashed static assets is max-age=0, must-revalidate, which meant every open of every email re-fetched all four icons and the logo through Gmail's image proxy -- six uncacheable round trips each time, and one of them intermittently failed to arrive. Thirty days: long enough that a reader fetches them once, short enough that replacing the artwork does not need a new filename to take effect.
